title: Bobby Ray Inman tape recorded at the IDA
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Bobby Ray Inman tape recorded at the IDA, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> a lot was the the tape with um um uh Bobby R Bobby Rinman >> when he got asked those questions. That was at the IDA.

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron, on Jesse Michels's podcast, mentions a tape recording of a man named Bobby Ray Inman being asked questions about UFOs. Cameron says the recording was made at the Institute for Defense Analyses, a US defence research organisation. To Cameron, the tape is a key piece because of how Inman responded when those questions were put to him.
